entries.mitigation: Hard Mode: all four players stack inside the yellow Execute circle. After 30%, expect Execute to recur periodically, so do not scatter immediately after the last add phase.
Top the group before the hit, then purge or outheal Condemn. Use the Death Knell clear to reset Swirling Darkblade ground pressure.

entries.entry_name: Jailer and Torturer Adds — Executioner Jerensi
entries.mitigation: Interrupt the Jailer channel immediately. CC or block late in the Torturer's Blood Frenzy channel while burning the add wave to end immunity.
Assign the healer or a ranged DD as the dedicated farthest-player kite. Drop Storm Bolts at the arena edge and never leave a player standing in them, or Chain Lightning punishes the whole group.

entries.entry_name: Iron Atronach Spiders — Prime Sorcerer Vandorallen
entries.mitigation: During each mount phase, group in Lucilla's Icy Dome and chain the spiders into it before killing them so they cannot reach players and Combust.
Hard Mode: kite the chasing orbs away from the stack. A ranged player can deliberately step closer to take over the chase if the current target needs relief.
Slow the burn. Kill one atronach at a time and collect every dropped orb before pushing another boss threshold; uncontrolled add/orb overlap is the real enrage.
Tank blocks the heavy and healers cover the resulting absorb. Avoid reflex-dodge rolling on Veteran/HM because it enrages the boss.
Tank controls the moving boss while the group handles the current infusion's secondary hazards. Preserve clean ground rather than dragging Vortex through the stack.
Tank lines Garvin up with an unaggroed Duneripper and aims Noxious Boulder through it. Everyone else stays out of the line or blocks if crossing it.
Do not taunt, cleave, or otherwise aggro Dunerippers before the boulder hit. Slow damage after 40% so the last Duneripper is bowled before Garvin's 30% scream enrages anything still alive.
Break line of sight behind the arena rocks for the full channel. Re-enter only after the lethal line-of-sight damage ends.
Tank holds Garvin on a stable front/back axis; DDs and healer stand on the sides. Do not rotate the boss to chase the cone because that swings the opposite hit through the group.
Tank stays in melee range after Noriwen moves. If chained, purge or outheal the heavy DoT; walk her toward center before thresholds if that makes later movement safer.
Avoid the three traveling lightning lanes. In Hard Mode, give affected players extra room because the DoT also damages nearby allies.
Tank blocks Brand. Do not dodge roll it, since that enrages Noriwen.
Tank drags Orpheon with the moving safe zone while remaining separated from the group. Never let him stand inside Planemeld, where he becomes untargetable and can cast Forbidden Knowledge.
Tank blocks the non-dodgeable heavy; DDs and healer stay outside the tank's splash radius.
At 80%, 50%, and 30%, tank chains the small adds onto the large add and controls its heavy/AOE pressure while the group clears the wave before Planemeld movement resumes.
Prevent the cast by keeping Orpheon out of Planemeld. If it happens, time a dodge roll through the unblockable runeblade volley.
